sources.observation: Weathered sandstone frames open passages. The fragmentary pediments have turned ends and the roofs mostly survive as gables and lintels.

sources.credit: UNESCO Phnom Penh Office, CC BY-SA 3.0 IGO
sources.observation: The axial causeway enters a long crosswise façade. Low plinths, posts and eroded ornament leave open space between the walls.
Five successive gate locations run from the north stairs to the upper sanctuary. The top has two side buildings and a walled enclosure.

limitations: The modeled route and occupied footprints use the map. Individual risers, window tracery, ornamental end pieces and scattered fragments are approximate.
The protected surviving gates and open courts are modeled along the approach. Remnant upper sanctuary walls and the roofless galleries use approximate local heights.
Terrarium samples set relative elevations. The surrounding vegetation, escarpment and reservoirs remain host features.
